## Égua Branca (CR 11)

**XP** 12,800  
N Large magical beast (unique)  
**Init** +8; **Senses** darkvision 120 ft., low-light vision; Perception +20  


**Defense**


**AC** 29, touch 14, flat-footed 24 (+4 Dex, +1 dodge, +15 natural, -1 size)  
**hp** 184 (16d10+96)  
**Fort** +15, **Ref** +14, **Will** +10; **SR** 22  


**Offense**


**Speed** 60 ft., fly 30 ft. (perfect)  
**Melee** bite +23 (1d4+8), 2 hooves +22 (1d8+4)  
**Space** 10 ft.; **Reach** 5 ft.  
**Special Attacks** trample (1d6+12, DC 26)  


**Statistics**


**Str** 26, **Dex** 18, **Con** 21, **Int** 2, **Wis** 17, **Cha** 11  
**Base Atk** +16; **CMB** +25; **CMD** 39  
**Feats** [Dodgility](../../rules/feats/dodge.md), [Toughness](../../rules/feats/toughness.md), Improved Natural Attack (hooves), Iron Will, Multiattack, Run, Weapon Focus (hooves), [Improved Initiative](../../rules/feats/improved-initiative.md); [Power Attack](../../rules/feats/power-attack.md) (no feat needed)  
*House rules: Dodge is part of Dodgility; Endurance is part of Toughness; Power Attack needs no feat; in their place: Improved Initiative.*  
**Skills** Fly +12, Perception +20  
**Languages** Common, Sylvan (cannot speak)  


**Ecology**


**Environment** any  
**Organization** pair (with rider)  
**Treasure** none
